admissible_source_evidence.variant_a:
Your sharing, at a glance

Here is a friendly overview of how things are set up for you. The steward gets to see whether your weekly check-in was completed, your reminder settings and your sleep routine notes. Your evening reflection entries and your meditation session notes stay private to you. You are the only one who can change any of this, and you do it from the privacy page.
admissible_source_evidence.variant_b:
Sharing summary for the member's account

Shared with the steward:
- whether the weekly check-in was completed
- reminder settings

Kept private to the member:
- evening reflection entries
- sleep routine notes
- meditation session notes

Only the member can change this summary, from the privacy page.
